# FIXTURE: a registration that fits its settings on Binance

Not a registration (OPS-PREREG-FIT-VENUE-GATE-W1). The worked example of PROCEDURE §4e's first form: the settings are fitted on Binance data from the stated date, and every other served venue runs the frozen settings as the check.

FIT_VENUE: BINANCE · from 2020-01-01 · check: ALL_SERVED_VENUES

## 1. Corpus

Binance USDⓈ-M perps, daily bars. Funding is read per hour; volume and open interest as a percentile of each coin's own history on each venue.
